hooks.command: python3 -c 'import sys,json,re;d=json.load(sys.stdin);c=(d.get("tool_input") or {}).get("command") or "";S=r"(?:^|[;&|]\s*|\$\(\s*|\b(?:sudo|xargs)\s+(?:-\S+\s+)*)";P=[(S+r"rm\s+(?:-\w*r\w*f|-\w*f\w*r)\b","rm -rf"),(S+r"git\s+push\b[^;&|]*\s(?:--force(?:-with-lease(?:=\S*)?)?|-f)(?=\s|$)","git push --force"),(S+r"git\s+reset\s+--hard\b","git reset --hard"),(S+r"git\s+clean\s+-\w*f","git clean -f"),(r"\b(?:psql|mysql|sqlite3|mongosh)\b[^;&|]*\b(?:drop\s+(?:table|database|schema)|truncate)\b","destructive SQL")];m=[n for p,n in P if re.search(p,c,re.I|re.S)];(print(json.dumps({"decision":"block","reason":"ai-kit guard: "+m[0]+" is destructive; ask the user to run or confirm it."})),sys.exit(2)) if m else None'
